1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “一天，他找到黄色的花。” / Formula: 有一天，+ subject + verb phrase / Correct: “有一天，神农找到了一朵黄色的花。” “有一天” is more natural for introducing an event in a story. Also, introduce who “他” is first; otherwise the reference is unclear.

items.reason: “他” has no prior referent, “找到” needs completed-event 了 here, and “一朵黄色的花” still does not fix the teacher-required specificity of 一种黄色的花.
